attributes.name: Tower Shield
attributes.powers:
At the start of any turn, display this card. While displayed, all damage dealt to you is reduce by 2, and the difficulty of your checks to defeat is increased by 1d8, or by 1d4 if proficient with heavy armors.

At the end of any turn, you may choose to recharge this card. If you do not, succeed at a Strength or Melee 6 check or discard this card.
